moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! 2026 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Ant & Dec return to Australia for the 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!, starting Monday on ITV1.

angles.name: Launch Night Buzz
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! is back on Monday. Who are you hoping to see brave the jungle this year? #ImACeleb

angles.name: Ant & Dec Are Back
angles.copy: Our favourite Geordie duo, Ant & Dec, are heading back to Australia! Get ready for the Bushtucker Trials as I'm A Celeb returns Monday.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing: Week 8 & Blackpool Prep
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing continues this weekend with Week 8 live show on Saturday and results on Sunday, as couples dance to avoid elimination and eye next week's Blackpool special.

angles.name: Weekend Dance Off
angles.copy: It's Week 8 on Strictly Come Dancing this weekend! Who are you backing to dazzle the judges and secure their spot for Blackpool? Tune in Saturday from 6:25pm.

angles.name: Road to Blackpool
angles.copy: Blackpool is just around the corner! The pressure is on for the Strictly couples this weekend as they perform for a place at the iconic Tower Ballroom.

moments.title: Premier League: Liverpool v Manchester United Showdown
moments.blurb: One of English football's fiercest rivalries reignites as Liverpool host Manchester United at Anfield on Sunday, November 22nd.

angles.name: Derby Day Anticipation
angles.copy: The biggest game in English football is just over a week away! Liverpool vs Manchester United at Anfield. Who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: History of Rivalry
angles.copy: Liverpool vs Man Utd is more than just a game, it's a clash of titans. Get ready for an unmissable Premier League encounter next Sunday.

moments.title: EFL Championship: Norwich City vs Cardiff City
moments.blurb: Cardiff City travel to Norwich City for an EFL Championship clash on Saturday, November 21st.

angles.name: Bluebirds on the Road
angles.copy: Big away day for Cardiff City next Saturday! They face Norwich City in the Championship. Will you be following the Bluebirds?

angles.name: Championship Action
angles.copy: Plenty of EFL Championship action next weekend, including Norwich City hosting Cardiff City on Saturday 21st November.

moments.title: Jack Savoretti Plays Utilita Arena Cardiff

angles.name: Cardiff Crooner
angles.copy: Jack Savoretti is in Cardiff tonight at the Utilita Arena! Who's excited for a night of soulful tunes?

angles.name: Live in Wales
angles.copy: Tonight in Cardiff: Jack Savoretti takes to the stage! A perfect Friday night out for music lovers in Wales.

moments.title: Republica Celebrate 30 Years of 'Ready To Go' in Exeter
moments.blurb: Nineties Britpop band Republica bring their '30 Years of Ready To Go!' tour to Exeter Phoenix tonight.

angles.name: Exeter's 90s Throwback
angles.copy: Exeter, are you 'Ready To Go'? Republica are at Exeter Phoenix tonight celebrating 30 years of their iconic hit! What a throwback!

angles.name: Britpop Legends Live
angles.copy: Saffron and Republica are live in Exeter tonight! Celebrating three decades since 'Ready To Go' dominated the charts. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Black Friday 2026 Approaches

angles.name: Start Your Engines
angles.copy: Black Friday is officially Friday 27th November, but the deals are already starting to drop! Are you ready for the festive shopping spree?

angles.name: Deal Hunting Season
angles.copy: With Black Friday just two weeks away, it's time to start eyeing up those deals! What's on your shopping list this year?
